quest.title: Hustle and Bustle
quest.description: You and Paimon have been at a loose end lately, so you decide to visit Qiaoying Village...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Unknown Item #363363 x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The mountain air is so refreshing! It makes Paimon feel like she could float around all day and never get tired!
...Cream! Gummies! Bulle Fruit!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, did you hear that...
...Sunshine! Blue Skies! Good Vibes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? So Paimon wasn't just hearing things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That voice sounds really familiar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we've got the time. Why don't we go check it out?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay. Let's go see what's up.

choices.text: Something about Bulle Fruit and good vibes.

talks.objective: Go and start up a conversation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh! What are they doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Navia! Clorinde!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ah! Well if it isn't my dear partners!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: See! I told you that something good was going to happen during our travels today! I have to say, sometimes The Steambird's astrology column is spot on.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: It's just your lucky day.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Are you guys also here to catch the festivities? Oh, and that reminds me, Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite to you too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, if you're here for Lantern Rite, then what are you doing on top of this deserted mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that voice we heard... That was you, right Navia?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oho, impressive! You could tell it was me from that far away! You've got good ears!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That, or your voice is just really loud...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well of course it is! After all, I am a Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Indeed. I suppose it's an asset.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure is! Having a loud voice is a handy tool when it comes to communication.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Wait wait wait! That wasn't even Paimon's point.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon just wants to know why you two were shouting from the top of this deserted mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There was something about Almonds maybe... and Bulle Fruit... Ooh! Is it some sort of secret code?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: No, it's not a code. The words are meaningless.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps. But the act of shouting was very meaningful indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: That's just what mountain climbers do, right? After all the hard work it takes to make it to the top, as you stand on the summit looking out at the vast scenery, it's not easy to resist the urge to release those emotions...

choices.text: I see. So it's not what you were shouting that matters.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Exactly! You get me, partner.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I was afraid that it would cause a disturbance, so I asked the locals around here, and they said it was fine. Apparently, most hikers like to shout when they get to the top, so the locals are used to it by now.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: So you see, it's not just me! I guess everyone shouts from the top of a mountain at some point in their life.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Speak for yourself.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: When you're stressed, don't you ever just get the urge to do something for no reason?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Not really. If I ever get stressed, I just go hunting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! That's a pretty good way to relieve stress.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: What I choose to hunt depends on my mood.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Ahem... Anyway, why don't you two give it a try? Shout anything you want. It's a real stress reliever!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... as long as Paimon has clothes on her back and food in her belly, Paimon doesn't think there's any stress that needs relieving.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And I prefer to keep things bottled up.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hahaha, I bet you guys are just too embarrassed to let loose.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: No need to be shy! Even Furina was shouting from the top of this mountain earlier.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? ...Did Paimon hear that right? Furina's also here in Qiaoying Village?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Believe in your ears. It is indeed as you heard.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Actually, the reason we climbed this mountain in the first place was also because we heard the sound of shouting.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Yep. We could just about make out someone yelling things like "Help me!" and "What should I do?". So we hurried up here to check it out.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: And what do you know, Miss Furina was standing right there all red in the face. She practically sprinted back down the mountain the minute she saw us...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Ah, that reminds me. I believe what she actually said was, "So help me, I will figure out what I should do about this script."

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: So you could actually hear what she was saying! Why didn't you say so earlier? I thought someone was really in trouble!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I figured we would come check out the situation either way. Why not let her keep some privacy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Seems like you caught Furina in the middle of some stress relief as well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She probably would have never thought... No, she definitely would have never thought she would run into anyone she knew all the way out here...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Was she alone?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I think so? We ran into Neuvillette on the way here as well, but he was already on his way back, so they probably weren't together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wha— Neuvillette was here too?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So many people from Fontaine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What was he doing here? It couldn't have been for vacation...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I think it just might have been, actually. But apparently, he only stayed for half a day before heading back. He's a very busy man.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Neuvillette is not the type to take much time off. Taking even a half-day for himself is already a huge step in the right direction.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Didn't Charlotte publish an article on the Liyue tea industry recently? Maybe he was inspired to come buy some tea after reading that article. You know, just like you were!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: My situation is completely different. I'm here because I was asked to accompany you. The tea purchase is simply an added bonus of this location.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You Fontainians and your tea drinking...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Oh, it's not for me. I lost a bet with Wriothesley, and now I have to buy him something.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: It was just a spur-of-the-moment sort of bet.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Wriothesley gets really invested in that sort of thing. But he couldn't care less about what he wins in the end.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: You could give him mint plants that you plucked from the side of the road, and he wouldn't even mind.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: If only he was that easygoing when it came to talking business...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: In any case, I'm pretty sure the tea you bought is this region's specialty. What is it called again... Ah, Neuvillette even mentioned it earlier...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Yes, yes! That's the one!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You didn't really buy ten boxes, did you?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Please, do I look like someone who would fall for that sort of marketing trap?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Ah, that reminds me. You guys said you only came up here because you heard my voice, right? I hope it didn't put you out — you must have other plans for the day?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's right! Hu Tao!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A few days ago, we heard that a friend was going to be in Qiaoying Village, so we decided to come and see if we could run into her.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Oh dear, we've been chatting for quite some time. I'm sorry for keeping you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No harm done, partner.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hehe, that's good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should probably head out and look for Hu Tao.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: No need to stay on our account. We just got up here, so we're going to stay around for a little longer.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Go and meet your friend. We can meet up in Qiaoying Village later!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds reasonable to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good. We're gonna head down the mountain then. See you later!

choices.text: But the act of shouting itself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qiaoying Village is known for its tea. But you know what else they have with tea? That's right, dim sum!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Didn't Gaming say something about dim sum being eaten in the morning? Paimon wonders if we can still get some at this time of day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Afternoon tea might be more appropriate at this point.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, well that's fine too. Paimon doesn't care what kind of tea it is, as long as it comes with some tasty snacks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, let's see what kinds of yummy things we can find around here... Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P-Paimon's not seeing things, is she? Is that Furina standing between Zhongli and Hu Tao?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wonder what they're talking about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Zhongli knows a lot of stuff. Maybe he's telling Furina about Qiaoying Village?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Oh! Or maybe Hu Tao is trying to rope Furina into being one of her clients.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wanna make a bet?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, this isn't the Fortress of Meropide!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, Paimon could be convinced for the right price. Let's say loser buys the winner three huge bowls of Seafood Congee!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since Zhongli is there, Paimon bets things are pretty tame...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's decided then! Paimon votes for "tour guide Zhongli"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then I vote for "hustler Hu Tao".

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! No time to waste! Let's go see who's right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good afternoon, Hu Tao, Zhongli, and Furina!!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Oh great, now Paimon's shouting too...)

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oho, well aren't you a sight for sore eyes! Seems like our luck just keeps on growing!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That we were able to meet you both without prior arrangement must mean that this is quite the serendipitous meeting indeed.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: #Huh? Oh! So both of you are acquainted with {NICKNAME} and Paimon then.

choices.text: I have keenly felt the passage of time since our last meeting.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh? Looks like someone's learned a thing or two from Zhongli.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: #*ahem* I must admit, I'm a bit surprised to see you here, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: But seeing as you're a hero who's been all over Teyvat, it makes sense that you would be well-traveled and well-connected.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Since we have found ourselves in each other's company within this fertile land, allow me to take this opportunity to wish you a happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: It appears you have been to Fontaine then.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, given your proclivity to spread good deeds wherever you go, it's no surprise that you would make the acquaintance of a celebrity as illustrious and celebrated as Miss Furina.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Th—That's quite high praise...

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: What I mean to say is, you flatter me, Mr. Zhongli.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Although I've built up a certain following within Fontaine, it is no reflection of strength or wisdom.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I stand before you right now as nothing more than an ordinary traveler in search of beautiful scenery and creative inspiration.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: (There is definitely more to Mr. Zhongli than meets the eye. I could tell as much from our conversation earlier.)

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: (Given his breadth of knowledge on both academic and worldly matters, there's no way he hasn't heard about what happened in Fontaine...)

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: (...Is he just feigning ignorance for my benefit?)

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: No, no no. Aiya, you're no common tourist. I simply won't have you talk about yourself that way.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: (Huh? Does that mean Hu Tao also knows...!)

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: You may not have heard, friends, but—

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Uh, ahem, Miss Hu Tao...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Miss Furina is now one of my esteemed clients!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Oh... Yep!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh—!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay. You win...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Guess Paimon will have to break into the hidden stash at the bottom of her shoe.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Huh? What's this about winning something?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Don't tell me... You two were placing bets on us?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It was Paimon's idea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nuh-uh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We just saw you guys standing on the side of the road and couldn't help but take guesses as to what you were talking about.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh, I see. That means you, my friend, must have guessed that I was trying to promote my business to Miss Furina.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, you know me.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: That I do, my friend.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: What was Paimon's guess then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thought Zhongli was showing the newbie around.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Ah, by "newbie" you mean me, right?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If that's the case, then Paimon's guess was also correct.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Oh, that's right! Mr. Zhongli was telling me about some great sight-seeing spots in the area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ha! You see! Paimon was right too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since both of our guesses were right, there can't be a winner or a loser!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Fine. Keep your secret stash then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, don't be upset, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about this. You buy Paimon a bowl, and Paimon will also buy you a bowl.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... As for the third bowl...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Since I was the subject of the bet, perhaps it should go to me? You know, as a congratulations for the huge deal I just struck.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll buy you a bowl any time you want.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hehe, I was just joking. Anyway, I should be the one treating you. The Funeral Parlor is about to bring in quite the sum, after all.

choices.text: So many chums all in one place!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I'm pretty sure you didn't learn that one from me...

choices.text: Judging based on the hat, I'd say so.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Paimon almost forgot to ask the most important question!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did, uh, something... happen recently, Furina?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Well, you know, with you enlisting the services of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and all...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, well, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? Oh no...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon is so sorry for your loss... Although Paimon may have not known the person, please accept Paimon's deepest—

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Woah, woah, woah. It's not like that, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But Paimon just thought... Since you hired the services of a Funeral Parlor and all... Hey, it's not that big of a stretch!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Really, Paimon. It's not like you don't know me. Do I look like I know anyone who would ask me to coordinate their funeral?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Miss Hu Tao is simply helping prepare some props for my film.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Not too long ago, I read a collection of horror stories from Liyue. The content was spectacular. In fact, I still feel the need to sleep with the light on even now...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, that's not the point!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Now that Fontaine's biggest star has returned to the stage, I figured it's about time the industry enjoyed a breath of fresh air!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You might even call it a "breath of fresh t-AIR-or"!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Hey, that's pretty good! I'll have to remember that for my ad posters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon sees! That makes a lot of sense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So did you come to Liyue just to enlist the services of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well, not exactly...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: My original plan was to just relax and enjoy the sights. But then I ran into Miss Hu Tao and Mr. Zhongli, and well, you know the rest. I suppose it was meant to be.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It was a fated meeting indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Zhongli sure loves his lofty turns of phrase. But if you ask me, it's all thanks to that man who stopped to ask for directions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Who was it?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: It's someone you know. Wanna take a guess?

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: What! How did you guess that on your first try!?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Very impressive, my friend. Your guessing game is spot on today!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell everyone about your encounter with Navia and Clorinde at the top of the mountain...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: One look at the pitiful expression on Furina's face is enough to convince you to leave out the part about the shouting.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Miss Furina, those two individuals over there appear to recognize you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It's Navia and Clorinde!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: We saw you all chatting over here, and were wondering if we could join in.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Please excuse the interruption.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh, so polite!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #No apologies necessary. Any friend of {NICKNAME} and Miss Furina is a friend of mine!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ha, straight to the point. I like it!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone circles around you and begins to introduce themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Hu Tao's eyes light up when she hears about Clorinde's profession.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But a quick explanation from Furina and Navia seems to dispel some of her more misguided ideas.

talks.objective: Go to the village beneath the mountain

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, look! It's Neuvillette! We lucked out!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. It has been some time since our last meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Few people frequent this location. Since I was able to conclude my work early for the day, I thought I might take a walk and avail myself of this area's peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You call this early...? Do you always work this late, Neuvillette?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Strictly speaking, that depends on the agenda for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I am hardly bereft of time, however, so working late is of little consequence to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? If you have so much time on your hands, then why did you only go to Qiaoying Village for half a day?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Hmm...?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: First, I should clarify that I was referring to my lifespan rather than the time at my disposal on any given day.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Second... I was unaware you possessed knowledge of my trip to Qiaoying Village.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give Neuvillette a quick summary of everything that happened today...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I see. Thank you for informing me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So did you deliver the gifts?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Yes. They have been safely delivered.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I have to hand it to Clorinde.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Just a simple gift delivery, and she has the great and mighty Iudex at her beck and call.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I was just passing through. It was merely an act of convenience.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Alright. Then I hereby confirm receipt of the goods on behalf of the staff of the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: A verbal receipt of confirmation? Is such a formality really necessary for a small matter such as this...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Guess not.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: This quantity of tea, though... Seems a little excessive for a gift, don't you think? Before you know it, they'll start accusing me of taking bribes.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Ah, about that...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Much of that is my own excess, I'm afraid.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh? Why, what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It was buy ten boxes get half off.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah! That explains it then.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Well, go ahead and leave them to me. I'll get through this stash as fast as I can.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: There's something else I'd like to give to you.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: This is...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: A stone... slate? Engraved with a symbolic design?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: While that is an apt description, it is, in actuality, a legal codex.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: ...A legal codex, huh... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Before the advent of modern writing utensils, information was recorded on stone slabs such as this. The law was no different.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Since ancient times, the scales of justice have symbolized the fairness and impartiality of judiciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: As a tribute to that sentiment, this slate was designed after a traditional legal codex and engraved with the symbol instead of text.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: During my travels recently, I chanced upon a roadside stall offering tourists the opportunity to try their hand at the ceramic arts... So I decided to have a go...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: We joked with Clorinde some time ago about gifting you a legal codex. So, here you go.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's what this is about.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I did not expect you to remember it as well. In any case, I hope this can be considered as a reasonable attempt to join in on the banter.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It is a very good attempt.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised. Even your sense of humor centers around the law. That's an impressive level of commitment.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: A gift of this significance deserves to be put on display, and I know just the place... Front and center in the Fortress's showroom.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Ah, surely there's no need for such a grand gesture...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Just kidding. I don't have anything like a showroom.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: But we do have a storage room... We can put it next to all the mechanical parts Sigewinne has collected.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That sounds good to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's what you were doing in Qiaoying Village!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Indeed. Of course, while I was there, I also took the opportunity to taste the local spring water.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The aftertaste is much purer than what I have delivered to me in Fontaine. It stands to reason that the long-distance transport has a tendency to imbue the water with extraneous emotion...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: If you want to experience the true flavor, you simply have to go the source... Perhaps I should organize some time off to do the same elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As they say in Liyue: "A balance between work and play is sure to keep your troubles at bay."

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Then we are of the same mind. It appears my desire is justified.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you say so. But you know you don't have to justify a vacation, right? You can just take one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all, you're hardly "bereft of time." You can do whatever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You're quite right. I suppose I suffer not from a lack of opportunity but rather a lack of inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: However, after reading a few articles about Liyue's holiday traditions, the idea popped into my head and made itself quite at home...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Seeing as I was free of responsibilities for the morning, I decided to depart at once.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how was it?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Refreshing. My spontaneous outing seemed to inspire quite a few other spontaneous decisions as well.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Take, for example, my foray into ceramics. At first, soil from the ground is granular and unforgiving, but add the right amount of water, and it becomes soft, moldable, and able to take shape.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: In the past, I never thought about how quotidian vessels were crafted. But now, I have participated in their very making.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: This is also something I made today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh wow. What a big... ladle?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a ladle? Paimon thought it was supposed to be some long-necked sea creature!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That was indeed one of my inspirations.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Really? You like it?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: To tell you the truth, given your unexpected arrival, I find myself quite unequipped to give you the welcome you deserve.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Around an important holiday such as this, human custom would dictate that gifts should be in order...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: But I'm afraid, this is all I can offer, if you'll have it, that is.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That is precisely why it would do me such a great honor if you accepted.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: You are most welcome. Happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, that reminds me...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You pass along the advice for Neuvillette's vacation...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Hmm, approve a leave of absence request for myself...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That sounds like it could easily lead to a vicious cycle of self-indulgence, something which couldn't be in further violation of protocol.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: But... I suppose I understand her point.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: My proclivity to refrain from personal outings does, in part, originate from a sense of responsibility toward my duties. But it is also due to a lack of desire to engage in the human world.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: But now I see that the human world is indeed full of many interesting places to discover.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I could have told you that.

choices.text: You made it by hand and everything...
The color also really matches your style.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: What do I have to do to get you to yell from the top of this mountain? Name your price.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: You really want to hear it that bad, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I'm just curious is all. I have a feeling you'll say something amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Hmm... I will pass.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I prefer to let actions speak louder than words.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh, that reminds me. A new year of work is about to begin.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: If there's anything you want to talk about, Zhongli, you know you can come to me. I'm all ears.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Does the Director have any concerns?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It just seemed like you were a bit preoccupied today, and much less talkative than usual. You barely said anything other than "Is that so?" and "Indeed".

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: If you ask me, I'd say you're having a mid-life crisis. You're getting to be around that age, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Is that so?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Haha, I jest.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Given its distance from the city, Qiaoying Village enjoys a much slower pace of life.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Surrounded by such peace and tranquility, I also seem to have developed a proclivity for inactivity.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I apologize for making you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ah. Um, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Is this atmosphere putting you in a lazy mood too?

choices.text: Out of mind, out of sight...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Wow! You are getting really good at these kinds of lines!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, everyone, make sure that you've got all your belongings with you before we leave.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: If there's any souvenirs anyone still wants to buy, the time is now.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Reliable as ever, Miss President.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Huh, what is that supposed to mean?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Clorinde is right, though. You really are reliable!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: It's not what she's saying, it's the way she's saying it!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: I will say, I never thought you'd be so easygoing outside of work, Clorinde.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: The tone of voice you use when you're working doesn't exactly make you seem like the type who enjoys interacting with people.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Well, I try to keep my professional and private life separate. That includes my behavior.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: #You take care now, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Your partner is very strong.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Trying to act cool now, are we? Haha, well I guess it's not an act for you, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: You are indeed quite strong.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it's been great talking to you all. I'm really glad I decided to come to Qiaoying Village.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Maybe we could go on another trip together sometime?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite marks the start of the new year in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: In the spirit of the season, then, I wish you a year of success as vast and endless as the open ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Clorinde said Neuvillette offered to deliver her gifts to Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So if we go to the entrance of the Fortress of Meropide, maybe we'll run into Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, we don't know exactly when he'll show up...
